newsitem.title: GREECE: ECU/DRACHMA SPIKES AFTER DEUTSCHE REPORT, DEPOS HOLD.
newsitem.headline: ECU/DRACHMA SPIKES AFTER DEUTSCHE REPORT, DEPOS HOLD.

text.p: Greek depos and implied drachma rates from forex forwards were little changed in late dealings but ecu/drachma was well bid after a report by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell that pointed to problems ahead, dealers said.
"We have seen some ecu buying from abroad after the report came out," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "Ecu/drachma spiked to 307.58 before falling back to around 307.50."

Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in its April report that the hard drachma policy of the central bank would go on for some time but prospective ERM membership, external imbalances and an overvalued currency signalled risk in 12-month ecu/drachma.
Money dealers said depos and forex forwards were holding low morning levels in late quiet trade in the liquid market.
FRNs and fixed coupon bonds were trading in unexciting ranges and prices were steady, bond dealers said.
"We have seen some offers in FRNs due 2003 but that's about it," said a bond dealer.
Greece will issue five-and 10-year CPI-linked bonds in May, deputy Finance Minister Nickos Christodoulakis told reporters.
The mark was quoted at 157.20/30 from Thursday's 157.210 fix, the dollar at 271.36/46 drachmas from 271.680 and the ecu at 307.45/55 from 307.440 drachmas.
